listings.name: Codfather Seafood & Sushi
listings.current_description: Codfather Seafood & Sushi is a long-running seafood restaurant in Camps Bay where diners choose from a fresh seafood display, alongside a sushi conveyor-belt bar, with ocean and mountain views.

listings.name: Coronation Bazaar
listings.current_description: Coronation Bazaar is a long-running family-run general store in Walmer Estate, trading from a building dated 1935 and stocking everything from sweets and toiletries to hardware, plumbing and electrical supplies.

listings.name: Debonairs Pizza Mitchells Plain Express
listings.current_description: Debonairs Pizza Mitchells Plain Express is a pizza and fast-food outlet in Town Centre, part of the national Debonairs Pizza chain, offering pizza and chicken meals for collection and delivery.

listings.name: Delft Community Health Centre
listings.current_description: Delft Community Health Centre is a Western Cape Government primary healthcare facility offering extended-hour care, including X-ray services, emergency stabilisation, 24-hour maternity care, chronic medication, child health and family planning.

listings.name: Den Anker Restaurant & Bar
listings.current_description: Den Anker is a Belgian restaurant and bar on the Pierhead at the V&A Waterfront, serving Belgian cuisine and a wide range of Belgian beers with views across the harbour.

listings.name: Deon Stuart Electronics and Installations
listings.current_description: Deon Stuart Electronics and Installations is a security and installations specialist in Rocklands, Mitchells Plain, offering alarm systems, CCTV surveillance, garage and gate automation, and network and IP cabling services.

listings.name: Department of Coffee
listings.current_description: Department of Coffee opened as Khayelitsha's first coffee shop and has been described as Cape Town's only township coffee shop, serving coffee and light refreshments from its Ntlazane Street premises.

listings.name: Diep River Roadworthy Centre CC
listings.current_description: Diep River Roadworthy Centre CC is a vehicle roadworthy testing and certification centre in Diep River, inspecting cars to confirm they meet the legal safety standards required to stay licensed.

listings.name: District Six Museum
listings.current_description: District Six Museum is a heritage museum on Buitenkant Street documenting the history and forced removals of the District Six community, offering self-guided visits and tours led by former residents.

listings.name: Dr C Podges Incorporated
listings.current_description: Dr C Podges Incorporated, trading as CP Dental and Aesthetics, is a family dental practice in Welgemoed offering general dentistry and aesthetic dental treatments with an emphasis on preventive care.

listings.name: Durbanville Fisheries
listings.current_description: Durbanville Fisheries is a fish and chips takeaway in Durbanville Town Centre with Portuguese and South African roots dating back to 1955, serving fresh fish alongside classic seafood takeaway fare.

listings.name: El Burro
listings.current_description: El Burro is a Mexican restaurant and bar in Green Point serving tacos, quesadillas and other Mexican street food alongside a large tequila and mezcal selection, with vegan options available.

listings.name: Empire Cafe
listings.current_description: Empire Cafe is a breakfast and lunch spot on York Road in Muizenberg, known for its organic coffee, an ever-changing menu, and sea-view balcony seating in a converted vintage building.

listings.name: Epping Property
listings.current_description: Epping Property is an industrial property brokerage based in Thornton, specialising in the sale and rental of factory, warehouse and industrial premises across Cape Town's Epping industrial node and surrounds.

listings.name: Equibox
listings.current_description: Equibox is an equestrian supplies shop in Noordhoek Farm Village, stocking riding apparel and tack from brands including Harry's Horse, Shires Equestrian, Imperial Riding, HV Polo and Premier Equine UK.

listings.name: Ergonomics Direct
listings.current_description: Ergonomics Direct is a specialist supplier of ergonomic office and home-office equipment in Paarden Eiland, with a showroom on Carlisle Street as well as a virtual showroom for remote consultations.

listings.name: Estora Home
listings.current_description: Estora Home is a furniture retailer in The Palms Décor and Lifestyle Centre, Woodstock, specialising in handcrafted couches, beds, coffee and side tables, and outdoor furniture with customisable finishes.

listings.name: Exclusive Books
listings.current_description: Exclusive Books is a long-established South African bookstore chain in operation since 1951; this Victoria Wharf branch stocks an extensive range of books, magazines and gifts alongside an in-store cafe.

listings.name: FPS Attorneys
listings.current_description: FPS Attorneys is a law firm in Brackenfell specialising in property, family and commercial law, offering services including conveyancing, litigation, debt collection, evictions, and the drafting of wills and estates.

listings.name: Golden Arrow Bus Services
listings.current_description: Golden Arrow Bus Services, founded in 1861, is Cape Town's major bus operator running around 1,300 buses across the metro; its Epping premises serve as the company's head office.

listings.name: Good Thyme Cafe
listings.current_description: Good Thyme Cafe is an all-day breakfast cafe inside Stodels Garden Centre in Milnerton, serving dishes such as poached eggs and milkshakes, with an outdoor play area and pet-friendly seating.

listings.name: Happy Rooster
listings.current_description: Happy Rooster is a Portuguese-style restaurant on the first floor of the Muizenberg Station building, serving trinchado steak and peri-peri chicken with sea views, with dine-in, takeaway and delivery options.

listings.name: HBC Systems
listings.current_description: HBC Systems is a manufacturer and supplier of emergency-services equipment in Epping Industria, including dual battery systems and solar panels, serving the emergency services industry for more than 15 years.

listings.name: Hypermed Pharmacy
listings.current_description: Hypermed Pharmacy is an Alpha Pharm-affiliated retail pharmacy on the corner of York and Main Road in Green Point, offering a dispensary along with general health, wellness and beauty products.

listings.name: Jumbo Cash & Carry
listings.current_description: Jumbo Cash & Carry in Ottery is a bulk wholesale store, part of the Massmart-owned Jumbo chain, stocking groceries, household goods and general merchandise for independent traders and the public.

listings.name: Kristen's Kick Ass Ice Cream
listings.current_description: Kristen's Kick Ass Ice Cream is an artisanal ice-cream shop in Noordhoek Farm Village, its original location since opening in 2015, making handcrafted ice cream from scratch using local dairy.

listings.name: La Femme Health & Beauty Salon
listings.current_description: La Femme Health & Beauty Salon has operated in Noordhoek for over 20 years, now part of the Noordhoek Garden Emporium complex, offering massages, manicures, pedicures and other beauty treatments.

listings.name: Little Fox
listings.current_description: Little Fox is a sister restaurant to Foxcroft at the historic Constantia Nek site, offering a la carte small and sharing plates for lunch and dinner seven days a week.

listings.name: LNR Computers
listings.current_description: LNR Computers is a computer hardware and IT services store inside Plattekloof Village, Plattekloof, offering system upgrades, virus removal, screen replacement, data recovery, custom-built computers, and a call-out repair service.

listings.name: Lotus River Community Health Centre
listings.current_description: Lotus River Community Health Centre is a public health facility on the corner of Delia and Anita Roads, offering general clinic and dental clinic services to the Lotus River community.

listings.name: Lotz of Joy Guesthouse
listings.current_description: Lotz of Joy Guesthouse is a 7-room guesthouse in Panorama offering en-suite rooms, free WiFi, free parking and breakfast, within easy reach of Tygervalley, Willowbridge and Canal Walk shopping centres.

listings.name: M&L Panelbeaters
listings.current_description: M&L Panelbeaters is a family-owned panelbeating and spray-painting workshop in Elsies River that has repaired vehicles in Cape Town since 1984, also handling general mechanical repairs and insurance claim assistance.

listings.name: Malok
listings.current_description: Malok is a homegrown South African fashion brand based at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, designing and producing feminine, versatile clothing from natural fabrics with a sustainable, ethical approach.

listings.name: Mango Ginger
listings.current_description: Mango Ginger is an owner-run coffee shop and bakery in Observatory serving wholesome, health-focused food since 2006, specialising in gluten-free, sugar-free and vegan cakes and a daily gluten-free, sugar-free cheesecake.

listings.name: Marble
listings.current_description: Marble is a fire-driven fine-dining restaurant on the top floor of the historic Union Castle Building at the V&A Waterfront, with a rooftop bar and wrap-around views over the harbour.

listings.name: Martins Bakery
listings.current_description: Martins Bakery is a bakery, deli and coffee shop on Main Road in Diep River, known locally as something of a hidden gem for its baked goods and light meals.

listings.name: Mediclinic Constantiaberg
listings.current_description: Mediclinic Constantiaberg is a private hospital on Burnham Road in Plumstead, with a 24-hour emergency centre and a multi-disciplinary Mother and Child Unit covering obstetrics, neonatal critical care and paediatrics.

listings.name: Moksh Indian Restaurant
listings.current_description: Moksh Indian Restaurant is a North Indian restaurant in Plumstead specialising in tandoor-cooked dishes and curries prepared by chefs trained in India, also catering for private functions and family celebrations.

listings.name: Montague Gardens Hardware and Steel
listings.current_description: Montague Gardens Hardware & Steel is a hardware and steel fabrication business in Montague Gardens, offering DIY tools, steel fittings, safety gear and custom steel fabrication services, trading since 1976.

listings.name: Mr O's Motor Spares
listings.current_description: Mr O's Motor Spares is a vehicle parts and accessories retailer at Total Garage in Portlands, Mitchells Plain, with an in-house workshop offering fitment services for the parts it sells.

listings.name: Mulholland Interior Solutions
listings.current_description: Mulholland Interior Solutions is a bespoke furniture and interior design studio in The Palms Decor and Lifestyle Centre in Woodstock, offering custom furniture, upholstery, curtains and blinds, wallpaper and metalwork.

listings.name: Parow Family Pharmacy
listings.current_description: Parow Family Pharmacy is an independent pharmacy on the corner of Jan van Riebeeck and Voortrekker Road in Parow, offering dispensing services with WhatsApp ordering and delivery to selected areas.

listings.name: Partners Hair Design
listings.current_description: Partners Hair Design is a full-service hair salon in Gardens Shopping Centre offering cuts, colour and keratin treatments, with walk-ins welcome and professional product lines including Kerastase, Redken and Moroccanoil.

listings.name: PEP Nyanga Junction
listings.current_description: PEP is South Africa's largest single-brand retailer, offering affordable clothing, footwear and homeware alongside cellular and financial services; this branch trades from Shop 51-52 in Nyanga Junction Shopping Centre, Manenberg.

listings.name: Pho Thy
listings.current_description: Pho Thy is a halal Vietnamese restaurant in Saratoga Court on Main Road, Kenilworth, serving pho and other traditional Vietnamese dishes made with fresh ingredients in a simple, unfussy setting.

listings.name: Plumstead Fisheries
listings.current_description: Plumstead Fisheries is a fish and chips takeaway on Main Road in Plumstead, next to the Checkers Centre, known for dishes such as hake, snoek and calamari served with chips.

listings.name: PNA Table View
listings.current_description: PNA Table View is a stationery, art and craft supply store inside Tableview Shopping Centre, stocking fine art materials, scrapbooking and craft supplies, student learning guides and general office supplies.

listings.name: PostNet
listings.current_description: PostNet in Gardens Shopping Centre is a branch of the national printing, courier and mailbox-services franchise, offering printing from A6 to A0, litho print-on-demand, and domestic and international courier services.

listings.name: Rare Grill
listings.current_description: Rare Grill is a small, dedicated steakhouse in Harfield Village with around 30 seats, focusing on wet-aged sirloin, rump and fillet steaks that are dry-aged on the premises before serving.

listings.name: Red Sofa Cafe
listings.current_description: Red Sofa Cafe & Deli is a neighbourhood cafe on the corner of Exner and Derry Streets in Vredehoek, serving all-day breakfasts, lunches and coffee with views toward Table Mountain.
